title: OpenAI's New AI Uses Your Computer, at Half the Price
description:
OpenAI has released GPT-6.1 Terra, a model built for computer use, visual reasoning and coding.
Its API price is half that of GPT-5.6 Terra, and OpenAI says it scores higher on professional computer tasks at about a third of the cost.
